content:
The [Ideal Weight Calculator](/ideal-weight-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Ideal body weight by four medical formulas. Enter your sex and height and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Ideal body weight formulas were developed for medical dosing and give a reference weight for your height. Comparing several shows a sensible range. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers. Related Health & Fitness tools include [BMI Calculator](/bmi-calculator), [Calorie Calculator](/calorie-calculator) and [BMR Calculator](/bmr-calculator). People also look for this tool as "ideal body weight calculator", "healthy weight for height", "how much should i weigh".

## How to use the Ideal Weight Calculator

Start by choosing your sex from the list, then entering your height (cm). The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Choose your sex from the list.
2. Enter your height (cm).
3. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
4. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Devine (men): 50 kg + 2.3 kg per inch over 5 ft. Robinson, Miller and Hamwi use different constants.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Ideal Weight Calculator](/ideal-weight-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. A 175 cm man has an ideal weight of roughly 66–71 kg depending on the formula. Try the same figures in the [Ideal Weight Calculator](/ideal-weight-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves. The steps are the same whatever numbers you use; only the figures change.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Sex: Male, Height: 175 cm), the [Ideal Weight Calculator](/ideal-weight-calculator) returns Devine: 70.5 kg, Robinson: 68.9 kg, Miller: 68.7 kg, Hamwi: 72 kg. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. Change any value and every figure updates instantly. ## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Treat these as references, not targets.
- Frame size and muscle mass shift the healthy range.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

## Frequently asked questions

### Which formula is best?

None is definitive; Devine is the most widely used clinically. You can see it in action in the [Ideal Weight Calculator](/ideal-weight-calculator) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

### Does ideal weight consider age?

No — these formulas use only height and sex. Try it with your own numbers in the [Ideal Weight Calculator](/ideal-weight-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What do I need to use the Ideal Weight Calculator?

Just Sex and Height. Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.

Yes. The Ideal Weight Calculator is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up. There is no limit on how often you use it, nothing to install, and no account to create — open the [Ideal Weight Calculator](/ideal-weight-calculator) and start straight away.
